analysis_unit: single-cell lineage trajectory within one channel

populations.observation_grain: one detected cell per (FOV, channel, time point)
exclusions: spine_length < min_spine_length removed before lineage linking (1.0.0)

metrics.GENERATION_TIME: division_time[1, :] (h), diff of consecutive division times
metrics.GROWTH_RATE_CYC: growth_rate[1, :] (1/h), polyfit slope of ln(spine_length) vs time_h per cycle

min_spine_length.ui_widget: float slider with adjustable min/max bounds

statistics.per_cycle_fit: OLS via numpy.polyfit deg 1 on ln(spine_length) vs time_h, R^2 reported

plots.TRAJ_VIEWER: spine_length (log y) vs time_h, per-cycle segments

validation_gates: no trajectory row with spine_length < min_spine_length when filter active
fully filtered channel returns None without error
sidebar parameter reaches process_channel_worker on Process Data
